notes: Measured by GC with the same high-temperature set-up as Table 4.7 (whose header reads 'y_w - ppmV'; GC calibrated in number of moles of water and CO2), so a mole basis is likely; this table prints only 'ppm'. No per-point uncertainty printed. Both temperatures are above the CO2 critical temperature; regime empty. Printed '%' signs moved to the deviation headers. 2026-10-11 coordinator: 'ppm' read as ppm by mole. Check against other laboratories in the database at the same T and P (interpolated in ln P): Table 4.13 CO2 over water, 100 and 150 C, 16-138 bar: ratio Teymouri/others 0.79-0.99 (Hou 2013b, Zawisza 1981, Caumon 2016, Tabasinejad 2011, King 1971); a mass basis would make the mole fractions 2.44 times larger (ratio about 2-2.4). Table 4.2 CH4 over water, 5 and 15 C: ratio 0.91-1.12 against Chapoy 2003/2005. Same instruments as Tables 4.4-4.7, printed 'y_w - ppm' and 'ppmV'.
